meta.description: Release calendar for Radarr, Sonarr and Seerr
offline.body: Agendarr cannot reach the server. The dates you last viewed are still shown when you reopen the calendar.
login.setup_body: Sign in with the Plex account that owns the server. That account becomes the Agendarr administrator and its Plex server is added automatically.
login.title: Sign in
login.body: Sign in with your Plex account.
login.body_server: Sign in with a Plex account that has access to the %s server.
login.waiting: Finish signing in in the Plex window. Closed it by mistake? Click the button again.
login.failed: Sign-in did not complete. Try again.
login.timeout: Timed out. Start signing in again.
err.no_owned_server: This Plex account owns no server. The first account to sign in must be the owner of the Plex server.
err.no_access: This Plex account has no access to this Agendarr's Plex server. Ask the owner to share their library with you.
err.expired: The Plex sign-in expired. Start again.
err.pending: Plex has not confirmed the sign-in yet. Start again.
err.plex: Plex is not responding properly right now. Try again in a moment.
done.title: Sign-in confirmed
done.body: You can close this window and go back to Agendarr.
setup.server_body: Your account owns several servers. Choose the one whose members will use Agendarr.
admin.users_lead: Any Plex account with access to the %s server can sign in. Administrators configure instances and manage accounts.
admin.delete_confirm: Delete %s? The account can sign in again as long as it has access to the Plex server.
privacy.intro: Agendarr is self-hosted: your data stays on the server of whoever runs it and is sent to no third party other than Plex.
privacy.stored: Your Plex id, name and avatar, your Plex email address, your Plex token (encrypted), your filter preferences, and the movies and shows your filters rely on (Seerr requests, watchlist, watch history).
privacy.why: To check that you can access the Plex server and to show a calendar filtered on what you care about. Nothing else.
privacy.cookies: A session cookie, required to stay signed in, and a language cookie if you pick one. No advertising or analytics cookies.
privacy.delete: Remove Agendarr from the authorized devices of your Plex account to revoke its token, and ask the administrator to delete your account: everything about you is then erased.
inst.lead: Radarr and Sonarr provide the release dates; Seerr provides who requested what. You can add several instances of each kind (a 4K one, for example).
inst.import_help: Copies the servers configured in Seerr, with their keys.
inst.name: Name
inst.name_help: Shown in the calendar, for example “Radarr 4K”.
inst.url_help: Address as seen from Agendarr, including any path. For example http://radarr:7878
inst.public_url_help: Address opened by the browser, for example https://radarr.example.com. Administrators then get a link to the movie or series from its details.
inst.api_key_help_arr: In Radarr or Sonarr: Settings › General › Security.
inst.api_key_help_seerr: In Seerr: Settings › General. Use the administrator's key.
inst.api_key_keep: Leave empty to keep the current key.
inst.err_url: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://.
inst.test_unauthorized: The address answers, but the API key is rejected.
inst.test_wrong_app: This address answers, but it is %s.
inst.imported: %s instance(s) imported, %s of them disabled because Agendarr cannot reach them: check their URL.
cal.empty_filtered: Nothing matches the filters in this period.
cal.no_instances_admin: No Radarr or Sonarr instance is configured.
cal.no_instances_user: The administrator has not configured any date source yet.
cal.failing: Unreachable right now: {names}. The dates shown may be incomplete.
cal.error: The calendar could not be loaded.
cal.sites_help: Sites offered on a release's details.
cal.mine_help: Ticking a box shows only what matches it; several boxes add up.
cal.mine_loading: First sync of your history, this can take a few seconds…
inst.welcome: Quickest: add Seerr, then “Import Radarr and Sonarr” copies its servers with their keys. Otherwise, add Radarr and Sonarr by hand.
inst.import_none: Nothing new to import from %s: its servers are already declared.
inst.import_needs_admin: the Seerr administrator's API key is required.
cal.why_no_seerr_user: your Plex account is not linked to any Seerr account.
cal.why_no_plex_server: the Plex server is not responding.
cal.why_plex_signed_out: your Plex sign-in expired, sign in again.
cal.why_unavailable: unavailable right now, showing the last known results.
sync.lead: Subscribe your calendar app (iPhone, Android, Outlook…) to your Agendarr calendar: releases show up with your filters and update by themselves.
sync.none: You have no subscription link yet.
js.copy_failed: Cannot copy: select the link by hand.
sync.ios_body: Open the link on the device and accept the subscription in Calendar.
sync.google_body: Add it from a computer signed in to your Google account; it then shows up on your Android phone.
sync.outlook_body: Outlook.com and Outlook for Windows or Mac accept the link as a subscription.
sync.qr_body: Scan this code with the camera.
sync.qr_alt: QR code of the subscription link
sync.limit_readonly: It is a read-only subscription: editing an event in your calendar app changes nothing in Agendarr.
sync.limit_filters: The feed applies your calendar filters (“For me”, movies, episodes…): change them in the calendar.
sync.limit_refresh: Apple and Outlook refresh about every hour; Google can take 12 to 24 hours.
sync.limit_secret: Anyone with this link sees your calendar. When in doubt, regenerate it: the old one stops working.
sync.regenerate_confirm: Regenerate the link? The old one will stop working and your calendars will need to subscribe again.
sync.revoke_confirm: Delete the subscription link? Your calendars will stop updating.
err.setup_taken: The first-time setup was just completed by another Plex owner account.
inst.test_no_host: Address not found: “%s”. On a Docker network it is the container name (for example seerr, radarr, sonarr).
inst.test_refused: The machine answers, but nothing listens on that port: check the port (Radarr 7878, Sonarr 8989, Seerr 5055).
inst.test_timeout: No answer in time: the address is not reachable from Agendarr.
inst.test_tls: The HTTPS certificate is not valid for this address: use the internal http:// URL.
inst.test_not_api: The address answers, but not with the expected API: check the path (URL base) and that no login page sits in front.
cal.why_syncing: first sync still running, reload in a minute.
